author: BBC News
description:
The US has withdrawn all its bombers aircraft stationed at RAF Fairford in the UK following an alleged terror plot to target the facility.  Washington has ben using the airfield to launch strikes on Iran, including deploying the B-1 strategic bomber. 

In a statement the Pentagon said: “We can acknowledge now that all US bombers that were deployed to RAF Fairford have redeployed to their home stations in the United States.”

The withdrawal of a dozen B-1 strategic aircraft comes after British counter-terrorism police arrested six suspects in connection with a planned attack on the base that US and British officials said was disrupted last Sunday.

Police initially detained five British men Sept. 27 near RAF Fairford after spotting three suspicious vans. The suspects were released on police bail while remaining under investigation. title: US pulls bombers from UK air base after suspected terror plot | BBC News

There are thousands of videos on social media of exotic animals being kept as pets. 
 
But, behind the clips lies a troubling reality. 
 
That's according to conservationists, who worry that content creators are glamourising the animals as pets, spreading misinformation about the behaviour they show. 
 
BBC Tech Now's Franchesca Hashemi investigates the consequences of viral social media videos of exotic animals, and whether they are fuelling the illegal wildlife trade.

title: Another Kyiv bridge hit in Russian drone attack. #Ukraine #BBCNews

author: BBC News
description:
Major bridges in Kyiv have been hit by Russian drone strikes for four consecutive days, as Moscow ramps up attacks on critical infrastructure in Ukraine's capital.
 
Two people were injured when the Pivnichnyi (Northern) Bridge was struck on Sunday morning for the second day in a row, while the Pivdennyi (Southern) Bridge was hit multiple times earlier in the week.
 
The latest attack came as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made a surprise visit to Kyiv in a show of support against Russia's continuing full-scale invasion.
 
Russia's military said it would be intensifying strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions. It earlier said it had hit the two bridges used to transfer Ukrainian troops.

Australian authorities are investigating the links between the country and a Flydubai co-pilot who attempted to take control of a plane travelling to Israel.
 
The co-pilot is alleged to have attacked the captain with a crash axe during a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv before passengers managed to overpower him and successfully take control of the plane.
 
Here’s what we know so far about the alleged attacker’s Australian links, and why authorities there are investigating.

Government research suggests that around two thirds of parents with young children feel overwhelmed by the amount of parenting information available and struggle with conflicting advice, with many turning to social media for support.
 
Faced with an array of parenting philosophies, or "brands" to choose from, is all of this advice helping parents or making them more anxious?
 
And is there really a best way to parent? Or are we losing our own intuition as we strive to become the 'perfect' parent?
